scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm prisma:migrate
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @rppg/shared-types typecheck && pnpm --filter @rppg/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @rppg/web typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @rppg/shared-types build --if-present && pnpm --filter @rppg/api build && pnpm --filter @rppg/web build
